preconditions.description: The number of students is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each reported student number is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= result_a <= n for result_a in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output is a student number between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(output[a-1] == find_second_hole(a, p) for a in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For each student a, the output correctly identifies the student who gets the second hole.
